dinners.note: Lamb quantities are bone-in RAW purchasing weights. Keep mash and spinach separate from the braising liquid. Dessert is the separate Monday cheesecake card. Total carbs (including fiber): Jake 12.0 g; Laine 8.6 g. Card carbs are NET.

ingredients.item: Beef broth - Jake 50 g, Laine 40 g
Butter - Jake 0.4 tbsp, Laine 1.175 tbsp

steps: Allow 2.5-3 hours. Pat the bone-in lamb dry; season with salt, pepper and the rosemary portion of the dried-herb blend. Brown in an ovenproof covered pan, 3 minutes per side. Add the measured broth and 150 ml water around the chops. Cover tightly and braise at 325 F until fork-tender, checking from 2 hours; add hot water only if the pan is drying out.

Lift lamb out and keep warm. Skim excess fat and boil the braising liquid uncovered until only 3-4 tablespoons of glossy jus remain. Stop when it coats a spoon. Do not pour unreduced braising liquid over the plates.

Steam the cauliflower until tender. Drain, then return to the hot uncovered pan for 3-5 minutes to drive off moisture. Blend with half the allocated butter and 20 g of the total cream. Salt to taste; do not add cooking water.

Wilt the spinach in a separate pan, squeeze out liquid and chop. Reduce the remaining cream in a wide skillet until a spatula leaves a trail for 2 seconds. Fold in spinach, Parmesan and remaining butter. Heat gently until thick; serve beside mash and lamb.

steps: Make Sunday so dessert is fully chilled. Bring 5 tbsp cream cheese to room temperature. Beat smooth with 1 tbsp sour cream, 0.4 tbsp lemon juice and liquid zero-carb stevia to taste (start with the bottle's one-serving sweetness equivalent).
Beat 1 egg separately. Weigh it and add HALF to the cheesecake mixture; cook and eat the other half with Sunday prep-day food, outside this plan. Mix gently until just combined.

Divide between 2 butter-free silicone baking cups or small ramekins. Bake in a water bath at 300 F for about 20-30 minutes, until edges are set and center has a slight wobble; egg mixture should reach 160 F.
Cool, refrigerate within 2 hours, then chill at least 4 hours. Serve 1 cup each Monday. No crust and no bulk sugar-alcohol blend.

Wednesday Nov 11: cook turkey for dinner and reserve Saturday lunch portions; thaw pork jar portions in the refrigerator and assemble Thursday/Friday jars.
